context: Algebraic geometry: sheaf of rings with local stalks

formulations.text: A locally ringed space is a topological space X together with a sheaf of rings O_X whose stalk at every point of X is a local ring.
formulations.editorial_note: Source-checked mathematical candidate; no independent human verification claimed.

context: Algebraic geometry: locally ringed morphism with local homomorphisms on stalks

formulations.text: A morphism of locally ringed spaces consists of a continuous map and a compatible morphism of structure sheaves, with induced maps on all stalks required to be local ring homomorphisms.
formulations.editorial_note: Source-checked mathematical candidate; no independent human verification claimed.

context: Commutative algebra: finite presentation of finitely generated ideals

formulations.text: A ring R is coherent if every finitely generated ideal of R admits a finite presentation as an R-module.
formulations.editorial_note: Source-checked mathematical candidate; no independent human verification claimed.

display_term: Primitive element of a field extension
context: Field theory: one generator of a finite field extension

formulations.text: For a finite field extension E/F, a primitive element is an element alpha of E such that the smallest subfield containing F and alpha is all of E.
formulations.editorial_note: Source-checked mathematical candidate; no independent human verification claimed.

context: Field theory: tensor-product injectivity under chosen embeddings

formulations.text: If fields K and L extend k inside a common field, K and L are linearly disjoint over k when the multiplication map from their tensor product over k to their compositum KL is injective.
formulations.editorial_note: Source-checked mathematical candidate; no independent human verification claimed.

context: Category theory: colimit of a span

formulations.text: Given morphisms B to A and B to C in a category, a pushout is an object P equipped with morphisms A to P and C to P agreeing on B, such that every other compatible pair of maps to an object T factors uniquely through P.
formulations.editorial_note: Source-checked mathematical candidate; no independent human verification claimed.

context: Algebraic geometry: left-cancellative morphism in the category of schemes

formulations.text: A morphism f:X to Y of schemes is a monomorphism when for every scheme T and two morphisms g,h:T to X, equality f composed with g = f composed with h forces g=h.
formulations.editorial_note: Source-checked mathematical candidate; no independent human verification claimed.
